instructions.mission: Fix quality gate failures for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}
instructions.context: Quality gate checks have failed. A failure report is attached below with the exact commands that failed, their exit codes, and full output. Your job is to apply minimal, targeted fixes so the quality gates pass.

steps.step: Read the qa-failure-report section below carefully. For each failure: - Identify the specific errors and their file locations - Determine the root cause (lint issue, type error, test failure, build error) - Note whether failures are related or independent

Fix ONLY what is broken. For each failure: - Lint errors: fix the specific lint violations reported - Type errors: add or correct type annotations as needed - Test failures: fix the failing tests or the code they test - Build errors: resolve compilation/build issues
CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: - Do NOT refactor unrelated code - Do NOT add new features or improvements - Do NOT change code that is not directly causing failures - Keep changes as small and focused as possible
Provide a brief summary of changes made: - Which quality gates were failing and why - What fixes were applied - Note: quality gates will re-run automatically after this step
